en.name: Dottore
en.ability: Each night*, all Dottore wake & choose a player: they die. If they're not an Archon, a player might be poisoned until dusk. You register as a Minion too. [All Minions are Dottore]

revisions.v1: Each night*, all Dottore wake & choose a player: they die. If they're not an Archon, a player might be poisoned until dusk. You register as a Minion too. [All Minions are Dottore]

en.flavor: Progress demands sacrifice, whether flesh or morality. Laugh if you will, fools, but my clones shall inherit Teyvat's secrets long after your bones turn to dust.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake up all Dottores. All Dottores simultaneously point to a player and kill that player. The player dies, and a "Dead" token is placed next to their character token. If player you killed is not Archon, ST can then choose another player and place a "Poisoned" token next to their character token. Put the Dottore back to sleep.
